name: wave-wipe
title: Wave Wipe
description: A grainy gradient of waves drifts up the frame while the outgoing scene lifts away and the incoming scene rises from the bottom. Rebuilt with a deterministic Canvas 2D gradient instead of the original WebGL shader. The block draws its own colored field between two built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .wvw-panel elements); to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels and keep the block on a track above.
useWhen: A smooth upward wipe with texture, for decks and chapter changes.
The brand has a gradient or grain look the waves can borrow.
avoidWhen: Clean flat-design pieces with no texture.
A fast cut: the waves need about two seconds.
author: Remocn
